👋 Hey everyone,
Yes, The AV Market Strategist is doing Black Friday too. Everyone else is, so I figured I’d join in.
If you’ve been thinking about a paid subscription for a while, this is the moment: 20% off, and the discount stays as long as you stay subscribed. That’s €80 a year instead of €100, this year and every year after. The offer runs until Monday, November 30, 23:59 CET.
The weekly newsletter is free, and it stays free. A paid subscription funds the deeper layer underneath it:
A growing library of living deep dives. Right now there are four: WeRide [ https://substack.com/redirect/03bcaf8d-9adc-4d0e-86c6-10a7830dc563?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ], Pony.ai [ https://substack.com/redirect/a14afe3b-6b81-48ce-8587-38fa6a35e538?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ], Momenta [ https://substack.com/redirect/ca376b38-f38c-48e2-b9ee-921a988f85c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ], and the AV fleet operations layer [ https://substack.com/redirect/31d4ce27-8267-47c8-af93-fa1805667f05?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ]. I’m adding more step by step, and every new one is included in your subscription.
Kept current, not published once. I update each file whenever the picture changes materially, so you have one document that’s up to date instead of a pile of old posts.
The full analysis behind the numbers. Financial breakdowns, unit economics, and what the line items show when they don’t match the company’s own explanation.
All of it is built on earnings calls, filings and the conversations I record on Autonomy Insiders with the people who run this industry.
If you already support this work, thank you. You’re the reason the deep dives exist.
Thanks for reading.
Daniel
